articles.summary: Camden National Corporation (NASDAQ: CAC; "Camden National" or the "Company") today reported earnings for the quarter ended December 31, 2025, of $22.6 million and diluted earnings per share ("EPS") of $1.33, both increases of 6%, when compared to the third quarter of 2025. For the quarter ended December 31, 2025, the Company reported a return on average assets of 1.28%, a return on average equity of 13.01%, and a return on average tangible equity (non-GAAP) of 19.06%. articles.summary: Camden National Corporation (NASDAQ: CAC) will report financial and operating results for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2025 on Tuesday, January 27, 2026. A conference call and webcast will be held at 3:00 p.m. Eastern on Tuesday, January 27, 2026, hosted by Simon Griffiths, President and Chief Executive Officer, Michael Archer, Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, and Renée Smyth, Executive Vice President, Chief Experience and Marketing Officer. Parties interested in listening to the teleconference should dial into the call or connect to the webcast link 10 – 15 minutes before it begins.
